name: emil-design-eng
title: emil-design-eng
description: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering philosophy as a skill: whether an element should animate at all, custom easing curves, durations, interruptible transitions, and the invisible polish details that make interfaces feel right.
why: Fills the collection's animation/motion-craft gap: no other entry covers animation decision-making or easing craft. It is the flagship of the source repo's 18 skills; the siblings are deliberately not imported (one per cluster), so the source repo is the pointer to the rest.
